name: kxflycancjfk
title: Will at least 50% of scheduled flights at JFK be cancelled on October 21, 2026?
settlement: Resolves YES if the percentage of scheduled passenger and cargo flights at JFK (KJFK) cancelled during October 21, 2026 is at least 50%. Certain 'Excluded Events' such as deliberate sabotage, unlawful interference, or malicious cyberattacks that directly cause the disruption may void or adjust resolution per the rules.
decideContext: You are estimating the effect of a news item on the percentage of scheduled flights cancelled at JFK specifically on October 21, 2026; the market resolves YES if that cancellation rate is 50% or higher, based on official airport/FAA cancellation data for that date.
